## Projects

- [Mentixo AI](https://luckyjoshiportfoliopage.netlify.app/projects/mentixo-ai): Full-stack AI study assistant with OCR doubt solving, AI quiz generation and learning analytics. Built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB and the Gemini API.

- [Periodic Table Game](https://luckyjoshiportfoliopage.netlify.app/projects/periodic-table-game): Responsive JavaScript chemistry game with multiple modes and a high-score leaderboard.
- [Spyderman Shooting Game](https://luckyjoshiportfoliopage.netlify.app/projects/spyderman-shooting-game): HTML5 Canvas browser shooter with enemy waves, collision detection and real-time scoring.
